entries.title: 2003: The Galileo spacecraft is terminated by sending it into Jupiter's atmosphere.
entries.summary: Galileo was an American robotic space probe that studied the planet Jupiter and its moons, as well as the asteroids Gaspra and Ida. Named after the Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei, it consisted of an orbiter and an entry probe.

entries.title: 2019: A 5.6 Mw earthquake shakes the Albanian port of Durrës. Forty-nine people are injured in the capital, Tirana.
entries.summary: On 26 November 2019 at 03:54 CET (UTC+1), northwestern Albania was struck by a magnitude 6.4 earthquake with an epicentre 16 kilometres (9.9 mi) west-southwest of Mamurras.

entries.title: 2015: Adventist Health System agreed to pay $118.7 million to settle allegations of fraud. It was the largest a hospital network has ever paid.
entries.summary: Adventist Health System Sunbelt Healthcare Corporation is an American hospital network. It is headquartered in Altamonte Springs, Florida. It operates healthcare facilities across multiple states.
